text: Which reservoir achieves the maximum linear memory capacity MC = N exactly?
choices: A strongly nonlinear reservoir with large input scaling that drives tanh into saturation
Any reservoir whose spectral radius exceeds 1
A reservoir with the smallest possible spectral radius
A linear reservoir (tanh in its identity regime) driven by white noise
explanation: A linear reservoir (small inputs so tanh(x) ~ x, no bias) driven by white noise saturates the bound at MC = N, because all state variance is explained by linear correlations with delayed inputs. Strong nonlinearity/saturation spends capacity on nonlinear terms and lowers linear MC; rho > 1 breaks the ESP and collapses MC; and a very small rho gives very short memory, far below N.
